name: Elephant Falls
summary: Climb down a rocky path beside Elephant Falls, a broad curtain of water over a mossy cliff at Nam Ban, about 30 km from Da Lat. Make it a half-day out of town, go in the wet months for the full flow, and wear shoes with grip.
getThere: Car or motorbike to Nam Ban, about 30 km
heroCaption: Elephant Falls over the boulders at Nam Ban

notice.title: The rocks are wet
notice.body: The path down to the base is rocky and slick with spray. Wear shoes with grip, not sandals.

body: Elephant Falls drops as one wide curtain over a dark cliff, with moss and boulders at the foot. A rocky path takes you down beside the spray to the base.
The falls are at Nam Ban, about 30 km from Da Lat, so plan a half day with the drive. Come in the wet season, when the flow is strongest.

figures.caption: The curtain of water from the foot of the falls
figures.alt: Elephant Falls seen from below, white water over a dark cliff

gettingThere: Elephant Falls is at Nam Ban, about 30 km from Da Lat. Go by car or hired driver, or by motorbike if you hold the right licence.

legs.heading: From Da Lat
legs.body: Car or motorbike to Nam Ban, about 30 km.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. No gate price in the provincial or national tourism listings.
